clues.it: Luca era nella 6ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Anna e in Plancia.
clues.en: Luca was in the 6th column, in a different room from Anna and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 8ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 8th column, in the 2nd row and west of Dario.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 10ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 10th column, in the 4th row and north of Anna.

clues.it: Irene era nella 5ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Ugo e sul Molo.
clues.en: Irene was in the 5th row, in a different room from Ugo and on the Dock.

clues.it: Nino era nella 2ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Nino was in the 2nd column, in the 6th row and west of Dario.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a una sedia e a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Olga was beside a chair and north of Fabio.

clues.it: Paolo era l'unica persona su una corda, accanto a un barile e in Stiva.
clues.en: Paolo was the only person on a rope coil, beside a barrel and in the Hold.

clues.it: Anna era nella 12ª colonna, accanto a una corda e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Anna was in the 12th column, beside a rope coil and north of Dario.

clues.it: Ugo era a nord di Dario e in Stiva.
clues.en: Ugo was north of Dario and in the Hold.

clues.it: Dario era nella 9ª colonna, accanto a una rete e in Stiva.
clues.en: Dario was in the 9th column, beside a net and in the Hold.

clues.it: Fabio era a ovest di Ugo.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: Solo Luca può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 6ª è sua.
steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 6th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 8th.
